Title: Ultraviolet Radiation
Content: The `text(Sun)`'s radiation comes to `text(Earth)` as many different wavelengths of electromagnetic energy. `text(One)` form of energy is ultraviolet radiation. A person's overexposure to the `text(Sun)`'s ultraviolet radiation (UV rays) is the biggest risk factor for skin cancer. Some ultraviolet radiation is absorbed by the ozone layer, which is located in `text(Earth)`'s atmosphere. This ozone layer provides a natural protection for living organisms.
